rationale: JLC Terminal One is Swiss Life's co-investment vehicle for JFK New Terminal One, not a separate asset. Swiss Life's disclosed 0.4% look-through interest sits inside JLC's 30% and is not additive to the 100% sponsor cap table. Current direct sponsor ownership is Ferrovial 49%, JLC 30%, Ullico 19% and Carlyle 2%.
recommendedChanges: Keep one canonical JFK New Terminal One / JFK NTO LLC asset record.
Record Ferrovial 49%, JLC Infrastructure 30%, Ullico 19% and Carlyle 2% as the current direct sponsor cap table.
Record Swiss Life Asset Managers' 0.4% current look-through interest via JLC Terminal One Co-Invest L.P. inside JLC's 30% block and mark it non-additive.
Do not create a separate JLC Terminal One PortCo and do not count Munich Airport, contractors, lenders or operators as equity owners.
unresolvedQuestions: Swiss Life's exact November 2022 legal-close day is not publicly disclosed.
